# CurrentUserTenant

The tenant the calling user belongs to, as returned by `GET /users/self`.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | The tenant's id. |
| `name` | `string` | The tenant's display name. |

```json
{
  "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "name": "..."

```
